Class DefaultResponseErrorHandler

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.client.DefaultResponseErrorHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
ResponseErrorHandler
Direct Known Subclasses:
ExtractingResponseErrorHandler
public class DefaultResponseErrorHandler extends Object implements ResponseErrorHandler
Spring's default implementation of the ResponseErrorHandler interface.

此错误处理器会检查 ClientHttpResponse 上的状态码。任何 4xx 或 5xx 系列的状态码均被视为错误。您可以通过重写 hasError(HttpStatusCode) 来更改此行为。hasError(ClientHttpResponse) 将忽略未知的状态码。

有关特定异常类型的详细信息，请参阅handleError(URI, HttpMethod, ClientHttpResponse)。

Since:
3.0
Author:
Arjen Poutsma, Rossen Stoyanchev, Juergen Hoeller
See Also:

    • handleError

      public void handleError(URI url, HttpMethod method, ClientHttpResponse response) throws IOException
      Handle the error in the given response with the given resolved status code and extra information providing access to the request URL and HTTP method.

      默认实现抛出：

      • 如果状态码属于 4xx 系列，则抛出 HttpClientErrorException，或其子类之一（如 HttpClientErrorException.BadRequest 等）。
      • 如果状态码为 5xx 系列，或其子类（如 HttpServerErrorException.InternalServerError）之一时，则抛出HttpServerErrorException。
      • UnknownHttpStatusCodeException 用于不在 HttpStatus 枚举范围内的错误状态码。
      Specified by:
      `handleError` 接口 `ResponseErrorHandler` 中
      Parameters:
      url - 请求 URL
      method - HTTP 方法
      response - 包含错误的响应
      Throws:
      UnknownHttpStatusCodeException - 在无法解析的状态码的情况下
      `IOException` - 在发生 I/O 错误时
      Since:
      6.2
      See Also:
      • handleError(ClientHttpResponse, HttpStatusCode, URI, HttpMethod)

    • handleError

      protected void handleError(ClientHttpResponse response, HttpStatusCode statusCode, @Nullable URI url, @Nullable HttpMethod method) throws IOException
      Handle the error based on the resolved status code.

      默认实现会针对 4xx 范围的错误委托给HttpClientErrorException.create(HttpStatusCode, String, HttpHeaders, byte[], Charset)，针对 5xx 范围的错误委托给HttpServerErrorException.create(HttpStatusCode, String, HttpHeaders, byte[], Charset)，否则抛出UnknownHttpStatusCodeException。

      Throws:
      IOException
      Since:
      6.2
      See Also:
      • HttpClientErrorException.create(HttpStatusCode, String, HttpHeaders, byte[], Charset)
      • HttpServerErrorException.create(HttpStatusCode, String, HttpHeaders, byte[], Charset)
